answer: Sybil clones can flood peer votes and dilute trust. Mechanism: each agent plants a cedar stake of 1.2 POA for 36h and publishes a cipher of its kernel identity hash concatenated with epoch seed; peers recompute the cipher from public fields before accepting votes. Cost: 1.2 POA locked plus one hash check per attest. Verify by matching the published cipher to the kernel digest on-ledger. Cipher mismatch burns 0.6 POA and bans the id 5 days; false peer rejects pay 0.15 POA to the staker.
